title: Formosar Chriotion for Self Determination 臺灣人民自決運動
content_html: Formosan Christians for Self Determination was a movement founded in 1973 to mobilize overseas Taiwanese to advocate for the right of the Taiwanese people to determine their own destiny. On March 19, 1973, four founders — including Reverend Huang Chang-hui — convened 21 representatives from across the United States and Canada in Washington, D.C. The following day, a press conference was held at the National Press Club, where the ‘Declaration of the Formosan People’s Self-Determination Movement’ was formally read aloud. The movement publicly declared its intent to unite overseas Taiwanese compatriots in pursuit of the sacred right and freedom of self-determination for the people of Taiwan.
